description: List the workspace's pages with their id, name, slug and published flag, optionally narrowed by a search on name or slug. Read-only and unpaged - returns count and items. The way to find a page's id or slug; its blocks and settings: get_page. Pages in the trash are not listed - list_trashed_pages.

search.description: Optional text to filter pages by name or slug

name: list_pages
title: List pages
